chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 25 – Han Li Tests the Green Liquid's Ripening Power
chapter_meta_description: Han Li discovers the green liquid ripens herbs overnight, but his joy turns to frustration when rain blocks his experiment. A chapter of cautious testing and cultivation patience.
